# Vendor sources: copies kept in case the pages change

Short quotations of Radium Performance's published material, © Radium Performance (see
[NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)). Recorded 2026-10-17.

## Mach One description (Radium's website, as pasted by the repo owner)

> Radium's R6 Trucks were born out of a relentless pursuit of stability, especially at high
> speeds. [...] That's why the R6 Trucks feature a 30 degree angle in the rear truck, providing
> rock-solid stability even when pushing the limits of speed.

Source URL: not recorded.

## R6 pre-order listing (as quoted on the esk8.news forum)

> 60 degree front, 30 degree rear pivot angle

- Quoted in a post by forum user "rusins", 2023-06-25, in
  https://forum.esk8.news/t/radium-r6-trucks-thane-belts/77112
- The original listing, https://radium-performance.com/products/radium-prototype-trucks-pre-order,
  returned 404 on 2026-10-17.
- This was a pre-order of prototype trucks. On 2026-10-17 the repo owner measured the production
  front truck's hanger face at 30 degrees from vertical with a phone inclinometer (which reads 0 against
  a wall), so the listing's "60 degree front" does not describe this board.

## Loctite 243 on plastics (Henkel technical data sheet)

© Henkel. Recorded 2026-11-21 from the local copy
[henkel/LOCTITE-243-TDS_COPYRIGHT-HENKEL.pdf](henkel/LOCTITE-243-TDS_COPYRIGHT-HENKEL.pdf)
(TDS LOCTITE 243-SG, August 2009):

> This product is not normally recommended for use on plastics (particularly thermoplastic materials
> where stress cracking of the plastic could result). Users are recommended to confirm compatibility
> of the product with such substrates.

Source URL: https://datasheets.tdx.henkel.com/LOCTITE-243-SG-en_GL.pdf (downloaded 2026-11-21).
